sections.text:
[Effects]
The following will activate if your Class is Archer:
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by S - XL.
Ignores 50% of the target's DEF and MDEF (cannot be stacked).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.
Only activates when playing as Archer.

[Activation Rate]
M+
